title: Priv EKS Terraform orchestrator: safe node drain, staged rollback policy, and health sentinel
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Terraform module and operator glue to provision Private EKS control planes with an explicit, auditable node drain and rollback policy. This ticket implements: (1) declarative module inputs for upgrade strategy (drain-order, max-unavailable, cordon-timeouts), (2) a lightweight sentinel probe suite that runs before and after each upgrade step (API responsiveness, pod readiness fuzz tests, KV cache smoke checks), and (3) an automated rollback trigger that reverts nodegroup launch-configuration changes or pauses a rollout and runs an emergency path when sentinels fail. The module must be idempotent, emit detailed upgrade telemetry to CloudWatch/Datadog, and provide clear hooks for customers to inject preflight jobs (e.g., migration tasks). This work plugs into the Private control-plane lifecycle pipeline and should be consumable both by the operatorless bootstrapper and the operatorized provisioning flow.
technical_decisions: Keep orchestration logic in a small Kubernetes controller (Go) that reads Terraform outputs instead of embedding complex lifecycle scripts in Terraform to preserve plan/apply separation
Use Terraform 1.7 with external data source patterns for drift detection and to fetch sentinel configuration from S3/GitOps
Sentinel probes implemented as k8s Job templates with a deterministic exit code map and thresholded retries (3 retries, 30s backoff)
Rollback model: reversible infra changes (nodegroup replacements) are implemented via immutable create-then-deprecate with automatic traffic shift based on probe pass percentage
Use IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) for the controller and limit KMS decryption to a scoped key for secrets retrieval
tasks: Spec: write module interface and examples (inputs/outputs)
Controller: implement drain/cordon controller and probe runner
Terraform: add external data source to integrate sentinel configs from S3/GitOps
Tests: e2e scenario for staggered upgrade with induced probe failures
Observability: emit per-step events to Datadog and add dashboard stub
Docs: Confluence design doc and example consumption guide
Security: KMS access policy and least-privilege IAM roles
acceptance_criteria: Module can perform a safe nodegroup replacement in a test account without losing more than configured max-unavailable pods
Sentinel probes can detect a regression injected into control plane components and cause pause/rollback
Terraform plan/apply cycle remains idempotent for repeated runs (no resource churn after success)
Controller logs include step-level telemetry and correlation id for each upgrade run
Automated tests covering successful upgrade, probe failure triggering pause, and full rollback path

notes: This ticket focuses on the control plane and nodegroup replacement path; worker-side rolling updates for managed nodegroups are covered in a sibling ticket. The probe suite should be extensible for customer-provided health checks via S3/GitOps override.
